Prevent exposed energized
or overheating hazards.

«requirement»
REQ-T-002 Electrical Safety
Comply with applicable household
appliance electrical standards.

Deliver selectable browning
without burning bread.

timingRequirement.label:
«requirement»

Heating duration within ±5%
of the selected setting.

«requirement»

under normal use.

within safe touch limits.

Disable heating if internal
temperature exceeds a safe threshold.

At least three distinct and
repeatable browning levels.

carriageReleaseRequirement.label:

Release on timer expiry
or user cancel.

Removal force no more
than 10 N.
